name: Curd Rice
steps: Rinse rice and simmer with measured water for 20–25 minutes until very soft. Mash lightly while warm.
Spread in a shallow bowl and cool promptly until no longer hot; hot rice can split curd.
Whisk curd with milk and salt. Fold into cooled rice, loosening with a little drinking water if very thick.
Heat oil, pop mustard seeds, toast urad dal until golden and add finely chopped ginger and curry leaves for 30 seconds.
Let tempering cool for 1 minute, then fold into the rice with coriander.
Serve promptly or refrigerate. Never leave cooked rice and dairy sitting warm for an extended period.
tips: Rinse grains before cooking, use a heavy pan and rest covered before fluffing or serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
